description: Selected metric fields from the published Kubeshark 53.6.0 validation archive. Original omitted zero-valued UI counters are expanded to zero only alongside retained metrics availability. No traffic payloads, infrastructure identities, private image references or collector revision IDs. RSS units MiB; CPU units millicores; bufUtil fraction. The original reports mark the harness modified and do not retain CPU resource settings, exact producer placement or current restart-availability attestations. Historical measurements are not retroactive acceptance under current tooling.
